designationHistory.name: Fort Clatsop National Memorial
designationHistory.indexText: Congress authorized Fort Clatsop National Memorial in Oregon to mark the Lewis and Clark Expedition's 1805-06 winter camp.
designationHistory.note: The act authorized the memorial and made establishment effective once at least 100 acres were in federal title; the NPS Index calls the 1958 date 'established'.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Oregon), 'Fort Clatsop National Memorial established May 29, 1958'

designationHistory.indexText: Congress redesignated Fort Clatsop National Memorial as Lewis and Clark National Historical Park and added sites in Washington as well as Oregon.

sources.name: NPS, The National Parks: Index 2012-2016 (Oregon), 'redesignated a national historical park Oct. 30, 2004'
